title: fix(grid): a narrowed list keeps every data cell clear of its fixed columns and shows its scrollbar
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6v19uPsX6gX42G8tGcvvzb)_
Fixes #35446

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSphdunq2aJq7ktuY

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化：AI 助手打开、窗口变小或记录抽屉打开、列表放不下时，每行的「⋮」移到名称列旁边一起冻结，不再压住金额等数据列；其余列横向滚动，底部滚动条一直可见；页头不显示说明文字，「导入」收进「⋯」，标题不再被截断。
- 为什么：右侧面板打开时，列表里的金额被「操作」列遮住，后面几列看不到，也没有任何提示。
- 如果判断错：只影响窄宽度下列表和页头的显示，不隐藏任何列、不改列配置，其他页面的页头不变；够宽时和原来一样。
- 需要您做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Row actions column (plugin-grid).** `useInlineRowActionFold` already folded inline primary row actions into the row's "⋮" menu while the table overflowed its scroll box. It now also answers `actionsFrozen`. While the table, menu-only, is still wider than its box, `ObjectGrid` draws the auto-pinned Actions column right after the frozen columns and counts it into `frozenColumns`, instead of pinning it to the right edge. The frozen zone never covers a column at rest, so every data column scrolls and none is covered. The column goes back to the right edge once the box is as wide as the table was when it moved. The move swaps the frozen zone's edge rule, which changes the width by a pixel or two, so the way back reads the width recorded before the move and cannot flip-flop. A frozen table that fits with more than 4 px to spare also goes back, so a table that shrank while frozen is not held there. The placement survives a data refresh.

Option picked, of the three the dispatch named: **join the frozen zone**. The card measured an opaque right-pinned cell over a clipped data cell (the geometry pin's overlap reading is 67.9 px on `origin/main`). A "⋮" shown on row hover would still cover a cell while it shows, and has no hover on touch. In the frozen zone the trigger is always visible, one click away, and covers nothing.

Not changed: an author's own `pinned: 'right'` columns (the author's layout, per the card's 「不改列表的列配置」), the grouped list (it disables frozen columns in its shared scroller), and a list whose table fits its box (the CONTROL cases).

**Scrollbar (components `data-table`).** While the table is wider than its box (`scrollsSideways`, read at mount and on resize), the scroll box draws its scrollbar at rest in the muted foreground. A table that fits keeps the shared hover-only bar of objectui#12708. This is the approach of the Studio Records tab fix (`RECORDS_SCROLLBAR_VISIBLE`) moved into the table, and applied only while the table actually scrolls sideways.

**List header (app-shell).** `PageHeader` gains an opt-in `compactBelow` (px of the header's own width). Below it, the one-row header does not draw the description, draws `foldedActions`, and drops the title's 60 % cap, which exists only to leave room for the description. Setup's two-line posture ignores it. Only `ObjectViewPageHeader` passes it (768, the `md` breakpoint read against the header's own width), so every other `PageHeader` page is unchanged. At 768 px and above, the list header is exactly as before, including the content-driven fold of objectui#12705.

## Tests

- `ui/e2e/list-narrow-pinned-columns-35446.spec.ts` (new Playwright geometry pin; the real `ObjectGrid` is bundled from source, styled with real Tailwind). Case: a 699 px main area (the card's AI-panel case), with and without an inline primary action. Checks: no fixed cell overlaps a data cell in the header row or the first body row; every data cell in view answers `elementFromPoint` at its centre; the "⋮" column sticks left after `name`; the scrollbar colour at rest is not transparent; the last column answers at its centre after a scroll to the end; Archive runs from the row menu. CONTROL at 1184 px: nothing moves and nothing is covered, and the bar stays hover-only. CONTROL at 699 px with columns that fit: Actions stays on the right.
- `ui/e2e/list-header-narrow-35446.spec.ts` (new; the real `ObjectViewPageHeader` with the actions its page builds, `useObjectViewHeaderChrome`, and the `action:bar` renderer). At 699 px: compact form, no description, no Import button in the row, New drawn, nothing spills past the header, the title is not cut, and Import runs from the 「⋯」 menu. CONTROL at 1184 px: description drawn, Import is a button, the actions are not folded.
- `PageHeader.actionsFold-12705.test.tsx`: new top-level describe for `compactBelow`. At 700 px: no description, folded actions, Import runs from the 「⋯」, title not capped. It follows width both ways (1000 px gives the full row, 700 px compact again). CONTROL: no `compactBelow` keeps the description, the three actions and the cap. CONTROL: Setup ignores it.
- `row-action-sticky.test.tsx` and `data-table-scroll-shadow-12463.test.tsx`: new top-level describes, as in the first round.
- Existing pin updated: `related-list-pinned-actions-width.spec.ts`, the case where the drawer overflows even menu-only, now asserts the Actions column has left the right edge. The jsdom pins of the right-pinned shape are unchanged and green.

<details><summary>CI red on ca569b439d, root cause and fix: the header pin's title-cut assertion</summary>

`Build & E2E UI` failed both attempts on the AI-panel header case, at the assertion that the title is not cut. CI reading: `compact: true`, `folded: true`, `spill: []`, `titleClipped: true`. The pin's measure is right; the header was wrong. In the compact form the title kept the one-row header's 60 % cap (`sm:max-w-[60%]`), which leaves room for a description the compact form no longer draws. With CI's fonts, the title 「Opportunities / Open opportunities」 is just wider than 60 % of the 521 px text block (312 px), so it was cut while about 200 px of the row stood empty. Locally the fallback font measured 291 px and passed, which is why the first local run was green.

Reproduced locally by making the fixture's view label long enough to exceed the cap in any font (`Open opportunities this quarter`). Red before the fix: `title.box 312, content 391, block 521, maxWidth 60%`, "the title is cut". The fix drops the cap in the compact form only. Green after the fix: `box 391, content 391, maxWidth 100%`. The full-width CONTROL keeps `maxWidth 60%`. The assertion is unchanged; the pin now also reports the title's box, content, block and max-width. Ablation of the fix (cap restored in compact, anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1): red with the same reading, restored blob == HEAD.

</details>

<details><summary>Readings and ablations</summary>

Grid pin on `origin/main` code at 699 px: Actions pinned right, overlap 67.9 px over `expected_revenue`, scrollbar `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)` (2 failed, 2 CONTROLs passed). This branch: `order [name, _actions, account, …, close_date]`, `frozen [name, _actions]`, overlap 0, `covered []`, scrollbar `rgb(100, 116, 139)`, `scrollWidth` 977 before and after the move.

Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored with blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty:
- `actionsInFrozenZone` forced false: grid pin red (overlap 67.9 px), `row-action-sticky` 2 failed.
- at-rest scrollbar forced off: grid pin red ("the scrollbar is transparent at rest"), the 12463 file 1 failed.
- the list page's `compactBelow` opt-in removed: header pin red ("the list header did not take its compact form"). The reading shows that on `origin/main` the 699 px header already folds Import (`folded: true`) but keeps its description.
- the description guard in `PageHeader` removed: header pin red ("the description is still drawn"), the PageHeader harness 2 failed.
- the compact title cap restored: header pin red ("the title is cut").
- Two attempts were refused by the tool as no-ops before running, because the replacement was a substring of the anchor. Each was redone with a distinct replacement.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Premise readings on `origin/main`: the name column was already frozen and the table already scrolled inside its own box; the header already folded Import into the 「⋯」 once its text would clip (objectui#12705). Still true were the Actions column over a data column at rest, the transparent scrollbar at rest, and the description drawn at a narrow width.
- The grouped list (a `groupBy` view) keeps its right-pinned Actions column over the shared scroller. Frozen columns are disabled there by design, and it is out of this round (not reproduced in a browser).
- Headless Chromium draws no scrollbar, so the grid pin reads the scrollbar's computed colour, not the room it takes.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- Round 1 (head 8e8ce3da47): `vitest run packages/plugin-grid/` plus the 76 components test files that name the data table: 364 files passed, 1 skipped; 3045 tests passed. `vitest run scripts/` (ui): 171 files passed, 5092 tests passed. Type-check of components and plugin-grid: exit 0.
- Round 2: both new e2e specs plus the related-list spec, green on the final head. PageHeader harness: 11 passed. Under the shared lock: `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check and `pnpm check:type-check-debt`, exit 0 (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- The derived gate families and the targeted app-shell tests on the final head are in the report on #35446.
- `overlap-check` clean before each push of this round. `Test UI` and the rest of the farm run in CI.

</details>
